        strength by repetition, footwork by boredom,

        everything else by refusing to leave it alone.

        born 2005. mexican / salvadorian.

        Shot 03

        twenty-one this year, and constitutionally unable to be satisfied with a number.

        the bar goes up, it gets logged, and before the plates are off he is already thinking about the next one. 405 was the goal for a long time. it stopped being impressive to him roughly a week after he pulled it. that is the whole personality — the thing is never finished, only current.

        seven days a week. three heavy, four on hands and feet — rope, footwork, slips, rolls, pivots. sauna and cold every week, mobility most days, one 72-hour fast a year, single-ingredient food eighty percent minimum. none of it is about looking a certain way. it is about still being able to do this in thirty years.

        films under filmedbyjaymes. designs under heartbound — every poster in this thing is his. same rule as the barbell: make it, look at it, remake it better, say nothing about it.
